recommendation: Keep the core source fix. As follow-up outside this core commit, review the FHIR Extension Pack pagecontent so extensions-datatypes.html has a RelativeTime section matching the existing core links.
issue_request: FHIR-12740 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU2 change request asking datatype pages to include links to pages listing extensions relevant to each datatype.
initial_application: Jira comments state the issue had been done, and no git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-12740 was found. Current datatype pages already had Extensions navigation links, and c5a1cbe migrated those links to the FHIR Extension Pack with per-datatype anchors; a later navigation-row commit regressed the mappings page to #primitive anchors.
additional_context: The edited datatype pages are active source under the current datatype page routing in source/fhir.ini. The Extension Pack source defines #primitives and title-case datatype anchors such as #Attachment and #Identifier; it lacks a RelativeTime pagecontent section even though a RelativeTime extension definition exists there, so that external page needs separate review.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes-definitions.html and source/datatypes-profiles.html to use Extension Pack anchors for primitive datatypes and Identifier. Updated source/datatypes-mappings.html so each datatype maps to its own extension anchor, and restored the adjacent conversion-link label to R4 Conversions to avoid duplicate Extensions labels.
source_changes: source/datatypes-definitions.html: changed primitive and Identifier extension navigation targets to #primitives and #Identifier.
source/datatypes-profiles.html: changed primitive and Identifier extension navigation targets to #primitives and #Identifier.
source/datatypes-mappings.html: restored per-datatype Extension Pack anchors for mapping-page extension links and restored R4 Conversions labels.
